page.notes: The page is a single text column with marginal line numbers in the right margin. The marginal "An.M." at top left is treated as a left-margin note. In the year table, the name "Semi" in 1658 is doubtful (the print looks like "Scini"). The age "70" in 1948 is printed with a symbol after the 7 that I could not identify. The first word "stoli" is printed with a long s that I have read as s. The final line "prima" has a faint mark after the "m" that may be a printer's ligature or damage.
